hooks.name: log-prompt
hooks.command: p="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$p/scripts/_pyrun.sh" ]; do [ "$p" != / ] || exit 1; p="$(dirname "$p")"; done; bash "$p/scripts/_pyrun.sh" "$p/scripts/log_hook.py" --tool=codex
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p=(Get-Location).Path; while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p 'scripts/log_codex.ps1'))) { $parent=Split-Path $p -Parent; if (-not $parent) { throw 'AI log launcher not found' }; $p=$parent }; & (Join-Path $p 'scripts/log_codex.ps1')"
